recipe.visualDefinition: A warm, dual-subject studio portrait featuring two men in dark clothing against a bright, abstractly lit white background, framed by thin, geometric sans-serif typography at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Staggered subject depth creating a sense of connection
High-key background contrasting with dark-toned clothing
Thin-line typography framing the central photographic subjects
Warm skin tones against a cool-white environment
coreInvariants: High-contrast value range between subjects and backdrop

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects positioned centrally; one slightly behind and higher than the other, filling the middle two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The smiling faces of the subjects, particularly the one in the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye enters at the top text, moves down to the subjects' faces, and rests on the large title at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant bright negative space in the upper corners and background to isolate the subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Bright white background providing a clean, high-key foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark grays in the clothing to ground the subjects.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Teal or cyan thin-line typography for a modern pop of color.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the subjects and the background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to white, black, warm skin tones, and one cool accent color

letterConstructionRules: Tight vertical spacing for primary title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ampersand scaled down and nested between larger words
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying weights and scales for consistency.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric precision and thin stroke.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of two Black men, one slightly behind the other, both smiling warmly. They wear dark sweaters/shirts. The background is a bright, clean white studio with soft, diffused lighting creating subtle shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, two-line title in the bottom third using a hairline teal geometric sans-serif. Add a smaller, single line of text in the top right corner in a light gray geometric sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Are the subjects' expressions warm and engaging?
Is the cyan/teal color used for the main title?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects

mustAchieve: High-contrast separation between subjects and background

postGenerationChecks: Check for text legibility against dark clothing
Ensure skin tones look natural and warm
Verify the 'hairline' weight of the font is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + High-Key Background + Hairline Geometric Typography + Cyan Accent Color
